name: engine-pin-recorded
body: Every frontend container states its engine pin with an exact version and the language-version ceiling that pin imposes. Where the ceiling is the user's installed toolchain rather than the pin alone (Go, Java, Rust), the container says so jointly. A frontend whose engine version is unrecorded is a violation; today that is C++, whose vendored tree-sitter/tree-sitter-cpp version must be recorded.
